name: Positive Percy Fox 1A production asset manifest
owner: Percy V1.1 design engineering; artwork approval is the owner's decision
status: PROPOSAL for stop gate P1. No pose or motion artwork exists. Nothing in this file authorises a new asset for production.

change_log.change: First issue: master record, 5 approved pose concepts, 6 new proposals, 7 motions, export spec, blockers.

master.name: Seated Percy (the logo mascot)
master.provenance: Vector trace of a 341 x 435 px crop of the approved refinement board (approved-1A-source-crop.png, sha256 4953497c7abfa450eaa09debbcdaa00571658ac1119fd6a1d30e08f2d1cfc66d). Not an illustrator-authored file.
master.structure: 3 paths, 0 curves, integer coordinates: body (1 closed shape), cream areas (4 shapes), star with three rays (4 shapes).
master.ship: IN PRODUCTION as the V1 logo. Owner fidelity sign-off for the live app is still recorded as pending in design/brand/RUNTIME_ASSETS.json.
rules: Never redrawn or recoloured per placement
Geometry is identical in every logo variant

export_spec.editable_source: One layered vector file per pose (SVG with named groups, or AI / Figma with an SVG export): head, ears, body, each leg, tail, tail marking, star. Curves, not traced polylines.
export_spec.svg: Optimised, transparent, no embedded raster, no text, viewBox cropped to the figure with 12 px clear space at 365 px width.
export_spec.png: Transparent, 256 / 512 / 1024 px on the long edge.
export_spec.webp: Transparent, 512 px on the long edge, for the app.
export_spec.proof_sizes: 48 px, 96 px and hero (144 px phone, 208 px tablet and up), each on cream, white and purple.
export_spec.paths: public/assets/brand/fox1a/poses/<id>.svg and .png (suggested; these folders do not exist yet)
export_spec.alt_text: Decorative uses are hidden from assistive technology. An informative use carries a short description of what Percy is doing.

poses.name: Walking Percy
poses.silhouette: Four-legged walking stride, head gently angled up, signature tail flowing behind.

poses.name: Leaping Percy
poses.silhouette: Clearly airborne full-body leap, legs extended, reaching towards the single yellow star.

poses.name: Reaching Percy
poses.silhouette: Standing on hind legs, front paws reaching up.

poses.name: Peeking Percy
poses.silhouette: Head and forepaws peeking around an edge; a genuine off-edge composition.

poses.name: Resting Percy
poses.silhouette: Clearly curled-up sleeping silhouette, calm expression.

poses.name: Waving Percy
poses.silhouette: Seated as the master, one front paw raised in a wave, head turned slightly towards the viewer.
poses.recommendation: Commission. The Home greeting is the most-seen placement.

poses.name: Celebrating Percy
poses.silhouette: Upright, both front paws up, tail high, the single star above.
poses.recommendation: Commission. Also covers reward_time with a different crop.

poses.name: Pointing Percy
poses.silhouette: Standing or seated, one paw pointing to the side at a piece of UI.
poses.recommendation: Commission if onboarding is restyled; otherwise defer.

poses.name: Thinking Percy
poses.silhouette: Seated, head tilted, one paw to chin.
poses.recommendation: Defer. Peeking already covers empty states.

poses.name: Encouraging Percy
poses.silhouette: Seated, leaning forward, one paw raised in a small cheer.
poses.recommendation: Do not commission. Reuse waving with a tighter crop.

poses.name: Reward-time Percy
poses.silhouette: Percy beside or holding a wrapped gift.
poses.recommendation: Do not commission. Reuse celebrating beside the reward's own artwork.

motions.name: Welcome wave / peek
motions.loop: Plays once on open; may repeat gently
motions.master_only_note: The unaltered seated master rises from behind an edge. A real wave needs a separate arm.
motions.reduced_motion: Static Percy in the final position.

motions.name: Award-point response
motions.master_only_note: Complete with the master: the figure hops as one piece and the star, already a separate shape, pulses.
motions.reduced_motion: No movement; the tile shows its green tick and the toast confirms.

motions.name: Today's Goal check
motions.master_only_note: Uses the award response until reaching artwork exists.
motions.reduced_motion: No movement; the row turns green and reads Done.

motions.name: Weekly milestone cheer
motions.master_only_note: Needs leaping artwork. Interim: the award response.
motions.reduced_motion: Static leaping pose (or the seated master) with the achievement banner.

motions.name: Reward redeemed
motions.master_only_note: Needs celebrating artwork. Interim: the award response.
motions.reduced_motion: Static celebrating pose with the confirmation message.

motions.name: Bigger goal reached
motions.master_only_note: Needs walking and leaping artwork. Interim: the award response.

motions.name: Resting / idle
motions.master_only_note: A slow breath and star twinkle on the seated master. A curled-up rest needs resting artwork.

motion_formats.app: SVG with CSS transforms on named groups (no new runtime dependency). Lottie only if an illustrator supplies it and the owner accepts the added library.
motion_formats.marketing: GIF and WebP (animated), MP4 for social, exported from the same vector source.
motion_formats.always: A static frame for every motion and a prefers-reduced-motion rule that shows it.

blockers.what: No illustrator-authored Fox 1A vector exists in the repository. The only original is a 341 x 435 px raster crop with callout lines over it and the paws cut off at the bottom edge.
blockers.clears_when: The owner supplies the designer's vector file or the full-resolution refinement board, or commissions a clean vector redraw and approves it against the board.

blockers.what: The current master is a polyline trace: edges are visibly faceted at hero size (144 px and up) and the body is one shape, so no limb, ear or tail can move.
blockers.clears_when: A layered, curve-based master is delivered (see export_spec.editable_source).

blockers.what: No artwork exists for any of the 5 approved pose concepts or the 6 proposals.
blockers.clears_when: An illustrator draws each selected pose from the approved master and the owner signs off the side-by-side face and tail check.

blockers.what: Colour differences between the trace and the documented palette: the star is #FFA600 (palette sunshine is #FFC938); inner areas are filled cream #FFF6E8 where the brief says white; the body is a #FF6A00 to #FF5200 gradient.
blockers.clears_when: The owner confirms which values are the brand's, and the master is corrected or the palette note updated.

blockers.what: Motions that move a limb (wave, leap, reach, walk, curl up) cannot be built.
blockers.clears_when: B2 and B3 clear for the poses each motion needs.

blockers.what: The stacked logo files cut off the bottom of the y in Percy: the lettering runs to the last row of the 800 x 890 canvas (measured on positive-percy-stacked-full.svg; the other three stacked variants show the same cut). The traced wordmark also has rough letter edges at large sizes.
blockers.clears_when: The stacked lockups are re-exported with clear space below the wordmark, from a clean wordmark source. These files are not edited in this work.
